# Runtime pallets

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/runtime-pallets.py from each runtime's construct_runtime!.
     Do not edit by hand: run the script. The pre-commit hook and CI run it with --check. -->

Every pallet in every runtime of this tree, by index, as `construct_runtime!` declares it.
Mainnet launches with the relay, Asset Hub and People runtimes named `pezkuwichain`; Zagros
runs their twins and, ahead of mainnet, Bridge Hub, Coretime and Collectives.

## Twins

Pallets present on one twin only. Each must be recorded with its reason in
`.github/scripts/check-twin-runtimes.py`, which fails on any that is not.

| twins | mainnet only | Zagros only |
|---|---|---|
| relay | — | — |
| Asset Hub | ToZagrosXcmRouter | Sudo, ToPezkuwichainXcmRouter |
| People | — | — |
